strings.1. Pobyt czasowy w Polsce — jak uporządk: 1. Temporary residence in Poland — how to put your legal stay in order
strings.Zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy to podstawow: A temporary residence permit is the basic way of legalising a foreigner's stay in Poland — granted for up to 3 years and confirmed with a residence card. The most common problems are: filing too late, choosing the wrong basis of stay and incomplete residence card documents.
strings.Kiedy złożyć wniosek o pobyt czasowy?: When to file a temporary residence application?
strings.Wniosek trzeba złożyć najpóźniej ostatni: The application must be filed no later than the last day of your legal stay (visa, visa-free travel or your current card). Filing on time and without formal gaps gives you legal stay for the whole proceedings. From 27 April 2026 applications are filed exclusively electronically in the MOS system — paper applications are left without examination.
strings.Pierwszy wniosek czy kolejny — czym się: First application or the next one — what is the difference?
strings.Karty pobytu czasowego nie przedłuża się: A temporary residence card is not extended — before it expires you file a new, complete application. With the next application the office re-examines your whole situation: work, income, insurance, place of residence. We help you file the first application, the next one and put your legal stay in order when there have been gaps.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> dobieramy: How we help: we choose the right basis of stay, complete the documents, file the application in MOS and watch over the case until you collect the residence card. Details: Temporary residence card — everything you need to know.
strings.2. Legalna praca i pobyt — jakie dokumen: 2. Legal work and residence — which documents you need
strings.Legalna praca cudzoziemca w Polsce wymag: Legal work of a foreigner in Poland requires two things at once: legal residence and a document entitling you to work. We check whether you can work legally and which documents you need in your situation.
strings.Jakie dokumenty pozwalają pracować legal: Which documents allow you to work legally in Poland?
strings.<strong>Zezwolenie jednolite</strong> (p: Single permit (temporary residence and work) — one voivode decision combining residence and work for a specific employer.
strings.<strong>Zezwolenie na pracę</strong> — u: Work permit — obtained by the employer, requires a separate residence title (e.g. a visa).
strings.<strong>Oświadczenie o powierzeniu wykon: Declaration on entrusting work — a faster path for citizens of selected countries.
strings.Czy mogę pracować, czekając na kartę pob: Can I work while waiting for my residence card?
strings.To zależy od Twojej sytuacji: znaczenie: It depends on your situation: what matters is, among other things, whether your previous document allowed work for this employer and whether the application was filed on time. Work without the required document is illegal employment — a risk of penalties and problems with the next legalisation. Before you start work, check your situation — we will assess your documents free of charge.

strings.3. Brak decyzji i długi czas oczekiwania: 3. No decision and long waiting time for a residence card — what to do
strings.Długi czas oczekiwania na kartę pobytu t: Long waiting time for a residence card is one of the most common problems of foreigners in Poland. Months without a reply, no letter from the office, a helpline that doesn't work — but the office's inaction is not a dead end.
strings.Co zrobić, gdy urząd nie wydaje decyzji?: What to do when the office does not issue a decision?
strings.<strong>Ponaglenie</strong> — pismo do o: Reminder (ponaglenie) — a letter to the higher authority when the case takes longer than the law provides. The office must respond to it.
strings.<strong>Skarga na bezczynność lub przewl: Complaint about inaction or excessive length to the voivodeship administrative court — when the reminder doesn't work; the court can order the office to issue a decision.
strings.Brak wezwania nie zawsze oznacza, że spr: No letter does not always mean the case is going well — it may have gone to a wrong address or to a representative you don't control (e.g. appointed by an agency). We check the case files, establish what stage the proceedings are at and take over correspondence with the office. More: No letter from the office — what to do.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> piszemy p: How we help: we write the reminder, prepare the complaint about inaction and act when the case takes too long and the office does nothing.
strings.4. Błędy i braki formalne we wniosku o k: 4. Errors and formal gaps in the residence card application — how to fix them
strings.Braki formalne wniosku to najczęstszy po: Formal gaps in the application are the most common reason a residence card case ends before it began. No signature, no photos, unpaid stamp duty, missing attachments — the office calls for completion, and if you don't make it, it leaves the application without examination.
strings.Co oznacza pozostawienie wniosku bez roz: What does leaving the application without examination mean?
strings.Urząd traktuje sprawę tak, jakby wniosek: The office treats the case as if the application had never arrived. You lose the legal stay resulting from filing — and often also the deadline in which you could have filed. That is why you must reply to the call to complete the gaps within the set deadline, completely and with proof of submission.
strings.Jakie błędy we wniosku zdarzają się najc: Which application errors happen most often?
strings.zła podstawa pobytu lub niewłaściwy typ: wrong basis of stay or wrong type of application,
strings.rozbieżności między wnioskiem a dokument: discrepancies between the application and the employer's documents,

strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> uzupełnia: How we help: we complete the documents, correct the application and prepare the case for filing — and when the call has already arrived, we reply to it on time.
strings.5. Zmiana pracodawcy lub warunków pracy: 5. Change of employer or working conditions — what to report so you do not lose your residence card
strings.Karta pobytu a zmiana pracodawcy to tema: A residence card and a change of employer is the topic where foreigners lose the legality of their stay most often. The single permit names a specific employer and working conditions — a new job, a different position or reduced hours usually require a reaction.
strings.Straciłem pracę — ile mam czasu?: I lost my job — how much time do I have?
strings.Utratę pracy trzeba zgłosić wojewodzie p: You must report the loss of your job to the voivode in writing within 15 working days. Reporting on time protects you from withdrawal of the permit and gives you time to find a new employer and file a new application.
strings.Zmieniam pracodawcę — co dalej?: I am changing employer — what next?
strings.Co do zasady potrzebna jest zmiana zezwo: As a rule you need a change of the permit or a new application — a new contract alone is not enough. We explain what must be reported and how not to lose the legality of your stay and work: Change of employer and the residence card.
strings.Kto powinien prowadzić sprawę o kartę po: Who should handle your residence card case — your employer or a lawyer?
strings.Jeśli kartę robił za Ciebie pracodawca l: If your card was handled by your employer or an agency, the case may be run in their interest, not yours — and when you change jobs you lose control of your own stay. Check your rights: Residence card — lawyer or employer?
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> zgłaszamy: How we help: we report the loss of work on time, prepare a new application or a change of the permit and take the case over from the employer or agency.

strings.6. Odmowa, cofnięcie zezwolenia, pobyt n: 6. Refusal, withdrawal of the permit, illegal stay — appeal against the decision
strings.Odmowa wydania karty pobytu, cofnięcie z: Refusal of a residence card, withdrawal of a permit or a stay that has become illegal — these are the hardest, yet still solvable, legalisation problems. Many negative decisions are issued for formal reasons that can be challenged.
strings.Dostałem decyzję odmowną — ile mam czasu: I received a negative decision — how much time do I have to appeal?
strings.Odwołanie od decyzji wojewody składa się: The appeal against the voivode's decision is filed within 14 days of its delivery — to the Head of the Office for Foreigners, via the voivode. After this deadline the decision becomes final, so every day counts.
strings.Mój pobyt jest nielegalny — czy da się t: My stay is illegal — can it be fixed?
strings.W wielu sytuacjach tak — możliwości zale: In many situations yes — the options depend on how the legal stay was lost and how long it has lasted. We analyse the case and look for a further legal solution; the sooner you react, the more options remain open. On withdrawal and expiry of permits: Withdrawal, revocation and expiry of a permit.
strings.<strong>Jak pomagamy:</strong> analizuje: How we help: we analyse the files, find the office's errors, prepare appeals and — when needed — a complaint to the administrative court.

strings.Zasiłki z ZUS zależą od tego, czy i do j: ZUS allowances depend on whether and to which insurance you are registered — not on citizenship. If you work legally and are covered by sickness insurance, you have the same access to them as a Polish citizen.
strings.Ubezpieczenie chorobowe jest <b>obowiązk: Sickness insurance is compulsory — you are covered from the first day of employment.
strings.Ubezpieczenie chorobowe jest <b>dobrowol: Sickness insurance is voluntary — you must opt in (registration by the employer). Without it there is no sickness or maternity allowance.
strings.<b>Sprawdź to koniecznie:</b> poproś pra: Be sure to check this: ask the employer for confirmation of registration for sickness insurance (ZUS ZUA). With a mandate contract this is the most common reason for a benefit refusal.

strings.Do okresu wyczekiwania zalicza się poprz: Previous periods of sickness insurance count towards the qualifying period if the break between them did not exceed 30 days. The sickness allowance is, as a rule, 80% of the assessment basis (there are exceptions, e.g. 100% during pregnancy or for an accident on the way to/from work).
strings.Przy objęciu ubezpieczeniem chorobowym i: On being covered by sickness insurance and the birth/adoption of a child. No qualifying period — from the first day of insurance.
strings.Na osobistą opiekę nad chorym dzieckiem: For personal care of a sick child or another family member. Also no qualifying period. Annual day limits apply.
strings.Po wyczerpaniu zasiłku chorobowego, gdy: After the sickness allowance is exhausted, when further treatment or rehabilitation offers a prospect of regaining the ability to work.
strings.Gdy niezdolność wynika z wypadku przy pr: When the incapacity results from an accident at work or an occupational disease — from accident insurance, with no qualifying period.
